hardGateFindings.finding: The control state, register, protocols, and public surfaces consistently preserve hiring-reader, collaborator, application, and hiring outcomes as not-yet-measured. Reader research and outward actions remain explicitly planned rather than completed, and repository work cannot advance their receipt states.

All eight blind spots have distinct signals, repository controls, triggers, owners, decision rules, next tests, and evidence-return paths. Render-derived composition inventories, exact-set role and proof ledgers, inquiry priorities, source-balance reviews, graph snapshots, and receipt state machines provide concrete failure surfaces.

The suite separates deterministic checks, digest-bound read-only LLM judgments, orchestration receipts, and external human evidence. It requires distinct sessions, prohibits the generator from deciding the result, and discloses that repository provenance is auditable process evidence rather than cryptographic proof.

Record-level boundaries are supplemented by a current digest-bound mosaic review covering affiliation, movement, collaborator, platform, educational-record, and reader-feedback combinations. The controls prohibit raw relationship graphs and identifiable feedback while recording minimizations, unresolved risks, and a repeat trigger.

requiredRevisions: Make the basis of public proof records machine-checkable when they lack canonical structured-claim links, for example by binding them to source relationships or explicitly retaining an unverified basis. The present proof ledger validates exact coverage and wording discipline but cannot independently validate every rationale-only basis.

Record a bounded parked or deferred disposition for the partially recovered inquiries outside the six-item priority set. Prioritization is strong, but an explicit queue-level disposition would better prevent the remaining inquiry population from becoming indefinite research debt.
limitations: This is an LLM repository-control evaluation, not human reader research, collaborator review, deployment approval, application evidence, or a hiring outcome. External outcomes remain not-yet-measured.

The stale current run, prior judge artifacts, and prior result scores were excluded. Deterministic inspection was used only to verify the supplied bundle digest and current non-run control consistency.
No conversation memory, private archives, or external facts were used.
The reader study, hiring-reader solicitation, and job-search follow-through remain planned and have no returned receipts, so their real-world usability and effect are unobserved.
